title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26942）：这篇的判断很克制——'proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards'。方法是 bounded、online 的 step-level repair：每步采样 K 个候选 tactic，失败的那个最多修 R 次，'Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place'。证据给得比较实：跨 K∈{1,3,5,8} 全部候选预算都优于 sampling-only baseline，'achieving up to a 32% relative gain and solving 82 additional theorems on a 1,990-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark'。最有价值的是它没有回避代价与边界——'Repair is not free: it trades extra runtime for reachable proofs'；收益分布是 'the first repair attempt capturing 84--96% of the total gain'；收益来源是可诊断的：'the gain comes almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatches'。并且做了第二次验证：'replicates on a second benchmark (Lean Workbook), nearly doubling the solve rate with zero regressions'。价值路由：跨域规则是今天就能用的那条——工具/编译器的精确错误消息是一等反馈信号，丢掉的每条错误都是免费信息；先修浅层失败、把修复预算集中在这类错误上性价比最高。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：abs 页未给出链接，待核验/暂无；pretrained repair model 的来源与训练数据摘要未说明，迁移到通用工具链需自行准备错误消息语料。今日动作：审计我们现有 agent 重试逻辑中 '失败即丢弃' 的分支，统计被丢弃的编译器/工具错误消息量。
